svg.title: meeg-utils architecture
svg.desc: Recordings are read with their BIDS sidecars, checked by the acquisition QC, preprocessed run by run (an EEG and an MEG lane), epoched and combined per session; every box names the class behind it, and every step can be changed, replaced or removed.
svg.text: Presets are defaults: change any box
Neuromag · CTF · KIT; OPM: S.HFC, no preset yet
BadSegments · ASR · SNS · Regression · HFC · ByChannelType
HTML report per run · dataset summary with outlying runs
